_comment: An example descriptor for a public remote MCP server: Context7 (library documentation). INSTALL.md step 9 registers it through the hub to show how a service you do not host is added. Its category, 'ai-intelligence', is auto-approving, so the registration is ACTIVE at once. The fields below are what registry(action:'register') takes.
name: context7-docs
description: Context7: up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples for AI coding assistants. Two tools: resolve-library-id (find the Context7 id for a library) then query-docs (ask a question against that library's docs). Public remote MCP server, no key needed.

tools.name: resolve-library-id
tools.description: Resolve a library name into a Context7-compatible library ID. Call this first before query-docs.

query.description: The user's question or task, used to rank results by relevance

tools.name: query-docs
tools.description: Fetch focused documentation for a library using its Context7-compatible ID. Use resolve-library-id first to get the ID.

query.description: The question or task to get relevant documentation for
